hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or ''; m='specs/' if (f.startswith('specs/') or '/specs/' in f) else ('fixtures/golden/' if 'fixtures/golden/' in f else ''); print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'WARNING: editing under ' + m + ' (' + f + ') - per AGENTS.md, spec changes and golden-file regeneration require human approval.'})) if m else None" 2>/dev/null || true
